reviews.text:
Clean and organized environment, the staff at the grooming and nail and fur trimming department are serious, professional, and very knowledgeable and patient with the animals.
The booking system is excellent.

Excellent!
They're the only ones who wash and dry dogs perfectly... my Labrador, Grace, smells wonderful for days! I live near Vomero, and I'd rather get stuck in traffic than have them wash her.
They're also very well-stocked and kind.
In an emergency, I took my medium poodle to this shop. Truly excellent, I was very satisfied. Fair prices. Come on, guys!
Super friendly, well-stocked shop, always available
Young, friendly guys, reasonable prices. Knowledgeable and helpful.
They are now treating my Zoe... kind and good.

A well-stocked shop, with courteous and friendly staff (a special mention goes to Cristina). The owners are courteous and professional, and Luigi is very careful to ensure the dog is completely dry before handing her back to her owner after grooming. I highly recommend it.
